landing.pricingTitle: Pay per event, not per month
landing.pricingBody: Joining is always free. A room covers one event, with {free} participants included.

faq.q: Do participants need an account or an app?
faq.a: No. Anyone can join from a phone or laptop browser with the room code. All they need is their name, with nothing to install.

faq.q: What happens if the internet drops?
faq.a: Screens keep counting on their own. The time is worked out on each device, so a short outage doesn't stop the clock, and screens catch up the moment they reconnect.

faq.q: What can I use as a screen?
faq.a: Anything with a web browser: a TV, the laptop on the projector, a tablet or a phone. Open the screen link and the timer fills it.

faq.q: Can someone else run the timer?
faq.a: Yes. Give any participant control from the operator page, and take it back whenever you like.
There's no subscription. You buy room credits for the events you run. See Pricing for details.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: Everything you need to run an event with Clepsy, one step at a time.

overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: Clepsy is a shared countdown timer for live events. One operator runs the clock, and every screen (the stage monitor, a tablet, anyone's phone) shows the same time, in sync.
steps: Sign in and create a room for your event, with its agenda of segments.
Open the room's screen link on the stage monitor, and share the room code with your crew.
Press Start. Every screen counts down together, and adjustments and messages reach all of them at once.
End the event when you're done. Its full timeline is saved to History.
overview.tip: Screens keep counting even if their connection drops, because the time is worked out on each device, not streamed to it.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: You need an account to create and own rooms. Joining a room as a participant never needs one.
steps: Click Log in (or Sign up) in the top bar.
Choose Continue with Google and pick your account.
You land on your Dashboard, ready to create a room.
signIn.tip: A room you own can be run from any device you're signed in on. No operator link needed.

createRoom.title: Create a room
createRoom.lead: A room holds one event: its agenda, its screens, and everyone who joins.
steps: On the Dashboard, open the Create a room tab and give your event a name.
Click Add segment for each part of the agenda, and set its length in minutes.
Click Create room. The operator page opens with your agenda loaded.
createRoom.tip: Each room covers one event. See Pricing for how room credits work.

buildAgenda.title: Build the agenda
buildAgenda.lead: Edit the agenda any time from the operator page. Every change reaches the screens right away.
steps: Type a segment name and length at the bottom of the Agenda card, then click Add.
Drag a segment by its handle to change the order.
Click Link to next under a segment to start the following one automatically when it reaches zero.
Click the pencil to edit a segment's duration, scheduled start, speaker, notes and wrap-up warning.
buildAgenda.tip: Scheduled start is for reference only. Nothing starts by itself unless segments are linked.

runTimer.title: Run the timer
runTimer.lead: Everything you do on the operator panel shows on every screen at the same moment.
steps: Press Start (or the Space bar) to run the selected segment. Press it again to pause.
Use −1 min and +1 min to adjust the time on the fly.
Near the end the time turns amber. In the final minute the screens flash to catch the speaker's eye, and past zero the time turns red.
Switch on Black out screens to hide the timer on every screen.
runTimer.tip: To move on, click the next segment in the agenda.

shareScreen.title: Share a screen
shareScreen.lead: Any browser can be a screen: a stage monitor, a TV, the laptop on the projector.
steps: On the operator page, find Share this room and copy the Direct screen link.
Open the link on the display and give the screen a name, like Main stage.
The timer fills the screen. Click it once to go full-screen.
The screen appears in your Participants list.
shareScreen.tip: On devices that support it, the screen stays awake while the timer is open.

joinRoom.title: Join as a participant
joinRoom.lead: Crew and speakers can follow the timer on their own phones, with no account needed.
steps: Open Clepsy and enter the room code under Have a room code?
Type your name so the operator knows who's watching.
The live timer appears, along with any message the operator sends.
joinRoom.tip: Signed in? You can also join from the Join with code tab on your Dashboard.

participants.title: Manage participants
participants.lead: Everyone who joins is listed on the operator page, where you can share control.
steps: Find the person in the Participants card on the operator page.
Click Give control. A banner appears on their screen, and one tap opens their own operator panel.
Click Revoke control to take it back. It applies from their very next action.
Click Remove to send someone back to the join screen.
participants.tip: Give control to your stage manager so they can run the timer from their phone.

history.title: End event & history
history.lead: When the event is over, end it to keep a full record of how it ran.
steps: Click End event on the operator panel and confirm.
Open History from the top of the operator page.
Pick the event to see planned vs. actual time for each segment, every adjustment and the full timeline.
Click Download .xlsx to get the same report as a spreadsheet.
history.tip: History is kept for every room owned by a signed-in account.
